**Private markets are being transformed — and you could be at the center of it.

**The gap between institutional grade private market tools and the technology that powers them has never been bigger. Trillions of dollars flow through private equity, venture capital, private credit, and real assets, yet the software managing this capital often lags a decade behind. SimCorp is changing that.

We're a fast-growing fintech company on a mission to modernize the private market ecosystem for institutional investors with cross-asset portfolios. We're scaling fast, our customers are the best in the world, and we're looking for a world-class Product Manager to help us build what comes next.

**If you understand the nuances of Private Markets, have a deep empathy for the professionals navigating this space, and know how to turn complexity into elegant software, we need to talk.

****WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As a key component of product management for Private Markets, you will own the product strategy and execution alongside our engineering team. You will sit at the intersection of finance and technology translating the intricate workflows of private market professionals into intuitive, powerful software that delights users and drives business outcomes.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role. You'll work directly with the leadership, clients, market participants, engineering, sales and go-to-market teams, and you'll have real ownership over a product area that is central to our company's growth. You will shape the roadmap, define priorities, and rally a talented team of engineers and designers around a shared vision.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Orchestrate high-stakes product demonstrations, executive roundtables, and client conferences to evangelize the solution and secure stakeholder buy-in across diverse audiences.

• Define, own and evolve the product roadmap for our private markets platform, balancing short-term customer needs with long-term strategic vision.

• Be the primary point of contact, the go-to person for private markets and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders.

• Strategically own, manage and prioritize the product backlog in lockstep with Leadership, balancing technical debt with high-value strategic investments to ensure seamless delivery.

• Deeply immerse yourself in the workflows of private markets - conducting interviews, shadowing users, and synthesizing feedback into actionable insights.

• Write crisp, well-reasoned product specifications and work hand-in-hand with engineering and design to ship high-quality features on time.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to author comprehensive user features and stories, establishing rigorous acceptance criteria to ensure all deliverables meet 'Definition of Ready' and 'Definition of Done' standards in the acceptance of deliverables.

• Define success metrics for every initiative and use data to evaluate outcomes, iterate quickly, and communicate results to stakeholders.

• Partner with Sales and Customer Success to understand market gaps, competitive dynamics, and the evolving needs of our customer base.

• Identify and evaluate opportunities to integrate AI and automation into core workflows — making complex workflows faster, smarter, and more reliable.

• Drive alignment across cross-functional teams, ensuring clarity on priorities, tradeoffs, and the 'why' behind every decision.

• Stay ahead of regulatory developments, market trends, and competitive shifts in the private markets technology landscape.

• Represent the voice of the customer in every product decision — advocating relentlessly for user experience without sacrificing business viability.

**Who You Are

**You're not just a product manager, you're a private market expert who happens to love building software. You've spent time in or around private markets and you feel the pain points firsthand. You're the kind of person who gets genuinely excited when you see a workflow for the first time and immediately start mentally redesigning it. You are rigorous in your thinking, persuasive in your communication, and relentless in your follow-through.

You thrive in ambiguity. You can take a messy problem, break it down into its component parts, and build consensus around a path forward without needing every answer handed to you. You care about craft: a half-built feature or a confusing UX genuinely bothers you. And you're a collaborator at heart, you know that great products are built by great teams, and you know how to bring out the best in the people around you.

**What We Value

**

• 5+ years product management experience, with at least 2 years in B2B SaaS or fintech.

• Meaningful exposure to private markets, whether through prior work at a PE firm, fund administrator, placement agent, LP, or financial software company serving these markets.

• Demonstrated track record of successfully launching products and features that users love and that drive measurable business results.

• Strong understanding of private asset structures, capital calls, distributions, investor reporting, and related workflows.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — you can write a tight one-pager and present to a room of skeptical executives with equal confidence and are not afraid to use AI.

• Proficiency in working with data: you're comfortable analyzing usage metrics and building dashboards to support your decisions.

• Experience collaborating with engineering teams in an agile environment; familiarity with modern development practices is a plus.

• High EQ and the ability to build trust quickly with customers, engineers, and senior leadership alike.

• A genuine curiosity about technology and its role in reshaping financial services.

• Experience engaging proactively with clients and stakeholders to solicit input for user stories.

• Broad knowledge of the Alternative Investment marketplace and system vendors.

• Experience with SimCorp Dimension® (advantageous but not required).

• Proven track record in roles such as Product Manager, Product Owner, Engineering, Business Analyst, Project Manager, or Consultant within software development.

• Strategic mindset with strong analytical skills focused on business outcomes and complete product offers.

• Ability to encourage, motivate, and influence teams and peers; contribute to improvements across the community.

• Understanding of how great products are built and deliver value to clients.

• Creative and inquisitive mindset with the ability to simplify complex concepts.

• Degree in Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Finance, or a related field (preferred).

**Why Join Us

**

• Meaningful ownership — your decisions will shape a platform used by some of the world’s most sophisticated investors, and your work will have visible, lasting impact.

• A culture built on trust, autonomy, and deep collaboration.

• A leadership team with deep domain expertise, proven execution experience, and a genuine commitment to building an exceptional, humancentered culture.

• The opportunity to build category defining technology in a space undergoing massive transformation where your influence won’t just move the product forward, it will help reshape an entire industry.

• A place where craft matters, ideas win on merit, and people are encouraged to think boldly, act decisively, and do the best work of their careers.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Azeta GUITI Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experience, ages, and backgrounds in general.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients. While striving to deliver client value, we believe it is vital to consider our people and our planet in every business decision we make. Acting responsibly is not just optional, it is essential.

About the position

Join MicroTech Software to build cutting-edge AI-powered tools for insurance professionals. Work on production RAG chatbots, agentic workflows, and voice-to-workflow capabilities.

At MicroTech Software we build cutting edge AI-powered tools that help insurance professionals answer complex questions faster and with greater confidence. Our flagship product is a production RAG chatbot used daily by insurance workers, and we are actively pushing its architecture in several new directions at once using the newest models. Your reference will be our AI Lead. We are looking for an engineer with 2–4 years of experience who has reached the point where writing good code is no longer the hard part — and who is ready to take on the harder questions: which approach to use, how to structure a system for long-term maintainability, and where to invest engineering time to get the most impact. You will work in a team with a very advanced team lead whom you can expect to learn from and alongside one or more junior engineers and be expected to help set the direction of their work as well as your own.

Responsibilities

• Shape the architecture of a live AI product

• Evaluate and challenge design decisions across the stack — retrieval strategies, LLM backend selection, service boundaries, data flow — and propose improvements with clear reasoning

• Participate in technical planning with the team and with insurance-domain stakeholders, translating vague requirements into concrete engineering tasks

• Identify technical debt, assess its cost, and make the case for addressing it

• Navigate an on-prem transition

• Design and lead the migration of a cloud-dependent LLM stack to a fully local alternative: self-hosted models, local embedding, and on-prem vector stores

• Evaluate open-weight LLMs for Danish-language RAG quality; understand the trade-offs in latency, accuracy, and hardware requirements

• Contribute to a RAG → GraphRAG transition: build a knowledge graph and integrate it into an existing RAG pipeline

• Design and build agentic workflows

• Design multi-step agent architectures using LangGraph or equivalent frameworks that can route, plan, use tools, and synthesize across document corpora

• Define tool-use interfaces, memory patterns, and failure handling strategies for agent loops running in production

• Work with domain experts to identify automation opportunities worth building

• Enable voice-to-workflow capabilities

• Contribute to the design of a pipeline that integrates local speech-to-text models into agentic workflows

• Evaluate Danish-language ASR quality, identify gaps, and assess the feasibility of fine-tuning or model selection approaches

• Design the integration points carefully — latency, error handling, data privacy — so voice becomes a first-class input channel

We are looking for someone who can say yes to

Must-have

• 2–4 years of production Python engineering experience, including async code, clean architecture patterns, and testable codebases

• Direct experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain or similar) in a shipped product or serious project

• Solid understanding of RAG systems: chunking strategies, embedding models, vector search, retrieval quality evaluation

• Familiarity with vector databases — pgvector, Chroma, Weaviate, Pinecone, or equivalent

• Comfortable owning a FastAPI service end-to-end: schema design, error handling, auth, containerization, deployment

• Ability to reason about architectural trade-offs and communicate them clearly

Strong advantages

• Hands-on experience designing or running local LLM inference — Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp — in a real rather than toy context

• Familiarity with knowledge graphs — ontology building, knowledge extraction, RAG integration

• Experience with agentic frameworks: LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or custom tool-use / planning loops in production

• Speech-to-text pipeline work — Whisper, Deepgram, Speechmatics, or comparable local STT — especially on non-English languages

• Experience designing hybrid retrieval systems (dense + sparse, BM25 + vector) and re-ranking with cross-encoders

• Familiarity with LLM observability and tracing tools (Arize Phoenix, LangSmith, or similar)

• Exposure to multilingual NLP, particularly Danish or other Nordic languages

Nice to have

• Knowledge of regulated-industry data handling, GDPR, or EU AI Act compliance considerations

• Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure preferred): managed services, container registries, CI/CD

Interested?

Send your application via our online form or directly to us.

Apply now

Or send to karriere@microtech.dk · Call us at +45 7585 9444 for questions

We offer

• • Beautiful offices at Viby J. station

• • Free parking

• • Opportunity to work hybrid

• • Competitive salary

• • Short decision-making process

• • Personal development

jobs.occupation: Senior Full-Stack Developer – Modern Engineering & Agentic Coding
jobs.description:
Senior Full-Stack Developer – Modern Engineering & Agentic Coding

If you care about doing full-stack development the right way – through clean architecture, automation, CI/CD, IaC, observability, golden paths, and engineering foundations – you’ll feel right at home at the Tech Collective, where we combine deep technical skills with real client impact.

What you’ll do

Life as a consultant is different from a typical in-house role. At the Tech Collective, consulting means working on a wide range of projects with various clients – so you'll regularly encounter new challenges and have plenty of opportunities to grow your skills quickly.

We believe AI and agentic coding accelerate great developer practices – they do not replace them. That’s why solid architecture, quality, security, maintainability, and sound technical judgement matter more than ever.

In this senior role, you’ll help us understand client needs and turn them into real outcomes by taking technical ownership, guiding teams, and delivering robust solutions from idea to production.

• 
Build, test, and deliver software using modern engineering practices such as everything-as-code, CI/CD, GitOps, automation, and open-source principles

• 
Act as a trusted advisor to clients, helping them make great decisions and turn ideas into practical solutions

• 
Work across frontend and backend technologies, taking part in architectural decisions, system design, containerised environments, and clear, maintainable documentation

• 
Improve developer and user experience by shifting quality left, applying strong design principles, mentoring others, and delivering minimum viable products with a clear path to scale

• 
Design, build, and operate platforms and infrastructure, including APIs, CLIs, platform engineering, immutable infrastructure, and internal developer platforms

• 
Collaborate, teach, and lead through effective communication, technical writing, code reviews, lean principles, and strong data and security practices

• 
Lead technical workstreams and collaborate closely with clients, translating business needs into pragmatic technical solutions

What you’ll bring

One thing that can be said of all your future colleagues is that we’re curious by nature, have a team-first mindset, a good sense of humour, and clear opinions on how tech can create value for our clients. If this sounds like you, you’ll be a great fit at The Tech Collective.

We’re looking for people with a relevant M.Sc. (this is mandatory and could be, for example, in computer science or software engineering) who are based within commuting distance of our office in Copenhagen.

We’re looking for someone with a minimum of 5 years of professional experience in full-stack software development or similar engineering roles.

On top of that, the ideal candidate is someone who brings senior engineering experience and:

• 
Communicates clearly in both written and spoken English

• 
Shares our values around software quality and delivery

• 
Enjoys working closely with clients and building trusted relationships with them

• 
Is tool-agnostic and chooses the right tool for the job

• 
Is comfortable with complexity and able to break problems down into manageable pieces

• 
Has solid experience building and operating modern software systems in production

• 
Understands software architecture, system design, testing, security, and maintainability

• 
Can guide technical decisions, challenge assumptions, and communicate trade-offs clearly

• 
Has experience mentoring or supporting other developers through code reviews, pairing, or technical sparring

Please note that you don’t need to meet all the criteria. The most important thing is that you have an engineering foundation, a senior mindset, consulting skills and curiosity to keep learning and growing.

What we offer

When you step into our office, you step into a world of nerdery – and we love it and intend to keep it that way. You’ll become part of a low-ego, high-trust team of sharp engineers who you’ll work closely with from day one.

Working with us means:

• 
Real autonomy, real impact: you’ll own features end to end and lean into the tech you care most about.

• 
Growth that matters: a learning programme, mentoring, and plenty of peer knowledge sharing.

• 
Community and craft: strategy trips, meetups, and events across The Tech Collective/Implement Consulting Group.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? Let us know why and how in your cover letter and apply ASAP.

We’re on holiday during July, so please expect slightly longer response times.

Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms.

**Welcome to Generation CE

**You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions.

As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations

• translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes

• ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends

• overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives

• strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams

• promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience

• bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team

• understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry

• have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management

• can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions

• communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.

**Pre-employment background checks:

**For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

jobs.occupation: The Associate Director of QC Support , Laboratory Systems and Equipment
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

Are you inspired by working in a company with ambitious goals? Our vision is that by 2030, Genmab’s knock-your-socks-off “KYSO” antibody medicines will be transforming the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases.

**The Role and Department

**Genmab's QC lab in Ballerup is growing in activities and we are now looking for an Associate Director of QC Support to join our team onsite in Ballerup.

The Associate Director of QC Support, Laboratory Systems and Equipment will be heading up the system team and equipment team, with the main purpose of supporting Genmab's QC operations within early- and late-phase as well as commercial products.

As a key member of the local QC leadership team, you will help shape and build a future-ready QC organization, ensuring scalable, innovative, and inspection-ready capabilities that enable accelerated development, successful product launches, and robust lifecycle management.

The role combines strategic leadership and transformation as a critical business enabler through digitalization, advanced analytics, and modern analytical technologies.

The laboratory is newly established, so expect a pioneering atmosphere, where you will help adjust the ways of working in an efficiency-oriented direction. We expect you to be ambitious, motivated, self-driven, and to be able to make your colleagues shine in an environment of respectful and flexible collaboration.

You will be joining a team of ambitious and professional colleagues within related fields, who can help you settle into your role, and keep the spirit high while performing the important tasks for our laboratory.

You will report to the Senior Director, Quality Control Lab.

**Responsibilities

**

• Build and lead the E-System Team providing business understanding, clear priorities and coordination of tasks

• Ensure a team environment that supports engagement, wellbeing and career development opportunities

• Develop, implement and maintain strategy and roadmap Laboratory Systems in Genmab's QC

• Ensure validation of relevant IT systems for the QC laboratory as System Owner

• Develop and manage the performance

• Serve as the primary point of contact across functional teams and external vendors

• Drive a culture of quality excellence, LEAN and continuous improvements

• Direct, guide, and monitor documentation and evolution of Standard Operating Procedures

• Support and participate in audits and regulatory agency inspections

• Ensure that QC employees comply with required safety and cGMP procedures and requirements

• Responsible for being compliant with Genmab's quality system

**Requirements

**

• It is expected that you hold a Master's degree in science or a related technical area

• Preferably 10+ years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and/or medical device industry

• Strong experience working in a cGMP environment with knowledge of laboratory IT systems, QC equipment, testing, sampling and release.

• Experienced people leader

• Experience in working in cross-functional teams to accomplish shared goals

• Strong experience working in analytical and regulatory requirements

• Significant applied experience in laboratory operations, including development and adherence to quality metric programs

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK734.400,00---1.101.600,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

In our delivery stream we cater primarily for dental laboratories. We are building both administrative software for dental laboratories (Lab Management Software – LMS) and AI-assisted dental CAD software (Automate) for designing crowns, bridges and other types of dental restorations with a clear strategy to converge these applications and offer seamless and smooth workflows for our customers.

Our cloud infrastructure is in Microsoft Azure. Our primary coding language is C# with Blazor for front-end and Pulumi for IaC. We use GitHub Actions and PowerShell scripts for build and deployment.

You will be joining the mature LMS team of app. 10 people distributed across Copenhagen and Kyiv, Ukraine. We in the LMS team have established sound processes; working in short iterations, high degree of test automation, frequent releases, relentless addressing of incoming bugs and continuous improvement. We have a strong focus on collaboration between everyone in the team and pride ourselves in having a great team spirit of having a good time while delivering high-quality work on schedule.

Your role

In this role, you will be a hands-on member of LMS team, spending most of your time designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining product features. Alongside your development responsibilities, you will help your and other teams incorporate secure development practices into their daily work and contribute to building robust and trustworthy solutions for our customers.

We see you as a developer picking up tasks from the prioritized backlog and working as a generally capable and engaged team member. We do not expect you to be a dedicated security expert or to own security activities alone. Instead, we are looking for someone who understands how to build secure cloud applications and can help the teams make practical security decisions while continuing to deliver business value. You will proactively propagate good security practices to developers, testers and the architect in the team, and you will take pleasure in motivating and propagating these practices to other teams, e.g. through our stream architect community, where you are expected to be a guest star.

We are yearning to hear your suggestions for initiatives to increase secure coding practices, e.g. tooling, courses, breakathons and penetration tests, and we expect you to establish a good and active dialogue with our chief security architect and kindred spirits in the company. We thus expect you to be proactively outgoing; sticking your nose into things outside your team scope, but for “the right reasons”.

Success in this role comes from balancing strong engineering skills with pragmatic security thinking while remaining focused on delivering great software.

Your profile

We are looking for a senior software developer with savviness for and proven experience in building secure high-quality cloud applications. Likewise, we see that you can check most of the following boxes:

• 
Senior-level Software development competences; C# and/or C++

• 
Proven hands-on experience with building secure large cloud systems

• 
Proven hands-on experience with cloud security engineering, including container, Kubernetes, IaC and CI/CD security

• 
Experience applying security concepts such as OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, secrets management, and API security

• 
Experience with IaC and DevSecOps, including tool chains and security scanning pipelines

• 
Familiarity with Azure operational and governance tools, e.g. Azure Advisor Security

• 
Interest in staying informed about emerging security threats and development practices

• 
Taking ownership, seeing the big picture, and having a pragmatic approach

• 
Strong collaboration and communication skills and fluent in written and spoken English

o You are influential, but not manipulative

o You are outgoing, but maintain your focus

We offer

• 
Strong focus on professional and personal development – and budget to back it!

• 
Empowerment and challenging tasks in a successful MedTech company with cutting edge technology;

• 
An inspiring international and informal environment with committed and highly skilled colleagues – we are more than 30 nationalities in our building;

• 
Attractive office in the center of Copenhagen, next to Kongens Nytorv metro station;

• 
Healthcare package to keep you fit and well, and fresh and delicious lunch cooked by our private chef;

• 
With us you will be part of the success that 3Shape has created over the past 20 years. You will be able to work on solutions used by thousands of dental professionals worldwide!

Join 3Shape and make a difference by changing dentistry together with dental professionals across the world by developing innovative solutions that provide excellent patient care in a rapidly growing industry.

Visit our website if you want to read more about our company, mission, or why 3Shape is a great place to work!

Get in touch now!

Please do not hesitate to apply for this exciting opportunity at one of Denmark’s most successful and fastest-growing high-tech companies, as applications will be processed continuously. We do expect to end our search for this position as soon as possible.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

About us

3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Git, Visual Studio, VS Code, JetBrains Rider, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines

Collaborative Attitude: You will be working closely with our team of Application Architects, shaping architectural decisions for supporting maintainable, scalable and robust systems

If you are passionate about cutting-edge software development technologies, leading agile teams, the EV industry, and creating outstanding products, join Spirii’s fantastic growth journey to lead the way for a sustainable future.

The Job

Spirii develops and provides world-class charging products and digital solutions to customers with electric cars. You do this through others: Tech Leads and Senior Engineers guide the technical work day-to-day, and you make sure good decisions get made, quality stays high, and the team keeps getting better.

Spirii is adopting agentic development as the way we build software. AI agents are becoming part of how our engineers design, code, test, review and operate systems. You'll make it real in your team, working with colleagues across engineering to shape how we do it.

You work very closely with a Product Manager and a Designer. Product owns what we build and why; you own how well the team delivers it. You report to the Head of Engineering.

Lead and grow your people

• Own the full people cycle for your team: hiring, onboarding, one-on-ones, feedback, career development, performance reviews and handling underperformance early and fairly.

• Build a team where people trust each other, take ownership and do their best work at a sustainable pace.

• Help your engineers grow, including senior engineers stepping into technical leadership.

Own team performance

• Be accountable for the team's delivery, predictability and quality, and for how it improves over time.

• Define with Product what good looks like, and track it with evidence such as delivery flow, reliability, and team health, not gut feeling.

Lead the shift to agentic development in your team

• Apply shared practices for quality, security and data handling as they develop, and stay accountable for what your team ships.

Collaborate across Spirii

• Partner with Product, Design, other departments and external consultants to align priorities and resolve dependencies.

• Communicate clearly and early about progress, risks and trade-offs.

What you'll do

This role cuts across multiple tech stacks and is a central part of how we deliver AI solutions for our clients.

In this role, you'll:

• Translating early ideas into working prototypes and iterating them into production-ready solutions using modern full-stack frameworks

• Designing and deploying generative AI applications and autonomous agents using LLM APIs and established agent frameworks

• Integrating AI capabilities into client systems and managing deployment pipelines in cloud environments

• Collaborating with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to build solutions that address real needs

• Mentoring junior engineers and keeping pace with emerging AI and software engineering paradigms

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone with at least five years of software development experience, including at least two in generative AI and agent-based applications, and a master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

• Full-stack capability across TypeScript (React, Next.js, Vite) and Python, with experience shipping production systems

You'll join a fast-growing team backed by Implement Consulting Group — nerdy by nature, genuinely curious about both technology and people, and serious about craft. You'll have real autonomy, a strong culture of learning, and meaningful AI challenges across industries.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the role once filled, so apply ASAP.
